items.name: Transactions
items.basis: Each tool wraps its COM calls in StartUndoMark/EndUndoMark; draw_hatch deletes its boundary polyline if hatch creation fails; undo/redo tools exist.
items.scope_and_limits: No batch, preview, checkpoint or rollback. Source shows partial writes on reported failure: draw_line/circle/... add the entity and then apply layer/color; if styling raises, the entity stays in the drawing while the tool returns success=false with no handle (no cleanup). Arrays failing mid-loop leave earlier copies. undo/redo send 'UNDO 1'/'_.REDO' asynchronously, sleep command_delay and return success=True without checking that anything was undone (false success, cap 2). No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable. Strict pass: undo/redo false success REPRODUCED against the stub (success=true, entities 3->3, only an async SendCommand queued); partial write REPRODUCED with an injected layer-write failure (tool returns success=false but the line remains). Item already below the cap of 2. Unchanged: 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no behavioral evidence; undo/redo report success unverified; partial entities left on reported failure.

items.name: Security defaults
items.basis: Default transport is stdio; HTTP default bind 127.0.0.1; erase/new/open/close/save/send_command carry destructiveHint annotations; save refuses when CAD is not connected.
items.scope_and_limits: send_command (arbitrary CAD command-line input, which can reach SHELL/LISP) is enabled by default with no allowlist or opt-in; open/save accept any filesystem path and save overwrites silently; streamable-http has no authentication and the host is configurable via --host. These are demonstrated permission-scope defects (cap 2). No committed tests, result logs, benchmarks or CI test runs exist at the pinned commit (the only GitHub Actions run is a Dependency Graph job, 34955979173), so no ordinary-path output evidence exists; anchors 2+ are unavailable. Strict pass: send_command forwarded '(command "_.SHELL" ...)' verbatim with success=true, REPRODUCED both in-process and over streamable-http on 127.0.0.1 without any credentials; a foreign Host header was rejected with 421 by the installed mcp 1.30 SDK (the repo allows mcp>=1.12, so that protection depends on the resolved SDK version, not the product). save_drawing accepts any path and creates directories. Item already below the cap of 2. Unchanged: 1.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: dangerous execution on by default, no path scope, unauthenticated HTTP; no adversarial evidence.

items.name: Long tasks

items.scope_and_limits: No cancellation; COMExecutor.submit waits on future.result() with no timeout, so a hung CAD blocks every tool; no crash recovery beyond reconnecting. declared_contract: A Python FastMCP server (v2.0.0, 35 tools) that drives a running Windows CAD application (AutoCAD, GstarCAD/GCAD or ZWCAD) over COM via pywin32: draw primitives, text, single-loop hatch and aligned dimensions; list layers/entities and read entity properties by handle; screenshot the CAD window; handle-based edits and arrays; undo/redo; layers; new/open/close/save drawings (DWG/DXF claimed by extension); block definition/insert; raw command passthrough; a legacy natural-language parser. Transports: stdio and unauthenticated streamable-http. No headless or file-based backend.
